# pbs_users (Data Source)

Lists users of Proxmox Backup Server, optionally filtered by realm. API tokens are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all users
data "pbs_users" "all" {}

# List only users of the built-in "pbs" realm
data "pbs_users" "pbs" {
  realm = "pbs"
}

output "pbs_user_ids" {
  value = [for u in data.pbs_users.pbs.users : u.userid]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `realm` (String) Only return users of this realm (the part after `@`, e.g. `pbs` or `pam`).

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled.
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration as Unix epoch seconds (`0` = never).
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `userid` (String) User ID in the form `name@realm`.
